title: Bench Tariff: Labour Rates and Named Task Charges of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service
content:
# Bench Tariff: Labour Rates and Named Task Charges

The Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service prices bench work from the tariff of the service level the work order runs at. The charges below are the level charges for jeweler time and for each named bench task, in USD.

| Charge | Standard Bench Service | Priority Bench Service | Master Jeweler Service | Heritage Restoration Service | Designer Authorized Repair Service | Atelier White-Glove Service |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bench rate per hour of jeweler time | 95.00 | 125.00 | 185.00 | 225.00 | 245.00 | 350.00 |
| Minimum labour charge on any authorised work order | 39.00 | 59.00 | 95.00 | 145.00 | 175.00 | 295.00 |
| Sizing a ring up, per full size | 48.00 | 62.00 | 88.00 | 125.00 | 140.00 | 195.00 |
| Sizing a ring down, however many sizes | 38.00 | 52.00 | 72.00 | 98.00 | 115.00 | 165.00 |
| Retipping a prong, per prong | 22.00 | 28.00 | 38.00 | 52.00 | 58.00 | 85.00 |
| Tightening loose stones, across one piece | 35.00 | 45.00 | 65.00 | 95.00 | 105.00 | 155.00 |
| Solder repair to a chain, per repair | 32.00 | 42.00 | 58.00 | 85.00 | 95.00 | 140.00 |
| Clasp replacement, part and labour together | 68.00 | 86.00 | 118.00 | 165.00 | 185.00 | 265.00 |
| Rhodium replating, per piece | 55.00 | 70.00 | 95.00 | 130.00 | 145.00 | 210.00 |
| Full polish and refinish, per piece | 42.00 | 55.00 | 78.00 | 110.00 | 125.00 | 180.00 |
| Engraving, per character | 4.50 | 6.00 | 9.00 | 14.00 | 16.00 | 25.00 |
| Pearl or bead restringing, per inch | 7.50 | 9.50 | 13.00 | 19.00 | 22.00 | 34.00 |

## Footnotes to the tariff

1. The bench rate is charged per hour of jeweler time. The minimum labour charge is the smallest labour charge any authorised work order at that level carries.
2. Sizing up is charged per full size the ring is taken up; sizing down is one charge however many sizes the ring is taken down.
3. Prong retipping is charged per prong; stone tightening is one charge across the whole piece; chain soldering is charged per solder repair.
4. Clasp replacement covers the part and the labour together. Rhodium replating and the full polish and refinish are each one charge per piece.
5. Engraving is charged per engraved character and restringing per inch of strand.

## Hypothetical readings

Engraving 12 characters on a hypothetical Standard Bench Service order comes to 12 characters at 4.50 USD each, 54.00 USD. Retipping 4 prongs on a hypothetical Heritage Restoration Service order comes to 4 prongs at 52.00 USD each, 208.00 USD. Sizing a hypothetical Priority Bench Service ring down three sizes is one charge of 52.00 USD; sizing the same ring up two full sizes would be 2 sizes at 62.00 USD each, 124.00 USD.
